people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Carchemish
people.line: Ancient city; site of Babylonian victory over Egypt

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Jehoiakim
people.line: King of Judah, son of Josiah

people.name: Josiah
people.line: King of Judah known for his religious reforms

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

people.name: Neco
people.line: Egyptian Pharaoh during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim.

translations.web: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.
translations.bsb: concerning Egypt and the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah:
translations.kjv: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaohnecho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.
translations.asv: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh-neco king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.
